title: List traversal work
statement: For a type of elements $\alpha$ and a natural number $s$ giving the work per step, define the traversal work of a list recursively: the empty list has work $0$, and a nonempty list has work $s$ plus the traversal work of its tail.
hypotheses_covered: Natural number $s$ for the work per step
